message.content: Li Hua and Wolfgang Schulz have a lunch meeting scheduled at the cozy café downtown at 12:00 PM. Gives us time to grab some food before. LiHua: Perfect! Let’s meet a bit earlier then to eat. Any place in mind?" Wolfgang Schulz then proposes, "How about that new burger place near the cinema? See you tomorrow! 🍔🎥" This indicates that Wolfgang Schulz mentioned a different event later in the day, but the initial lunch meeting with the cozy café downtown at 12:00 PM is clearly stated in the conversation.
